data.name: Accelerators_Available
data.value: Windows can add faster engines for this PC: {0}.

data.name: Accelerators_ToolTip
data.value: Execution providers from the GPU and NPU makers, through Windows ML. Windows downloads them from Microsoft; some are hundreds of megabytes.

data.name: CheckForUpdates_Description
data.value: At startup, asks github.com which Krupno release is the latest. Nothing else is sent, and a new version is only downloaded when you ask for it.

data.name: Compare_SideBySideToolTip
data.value: Original and result side by side

data.name: CopyErrorDetails_ToolTip
data.value: For a bug report: versions, GPU, model, settings and the error

data.name: Denoise_Description
data.value: Before upscaling, a separate model removes camera noise and grain. Slower, and it smooths fine texture: leave it off for clean images.

data.name: Denoise_Missing
data.value: The noise removal model isn't installed: tick it when installing Krupno, or put {0} into the models folder.

data.name: Dialog_Filter
data.comment: A file dialog filter: name|patterns|name|patterns. {0} is the list of image patterns.

data.name: Done_AllThere
data.value: All the results are already there

data.name: Done_Files
data.comment: {0} is the number of files (3 files), {1} the time.

data.name: Done_InTime
data.comment: {0} is the time, {1} the file size.

data.name: Done_LeftOut
data.comment: After "Saved next to the originals ·"; {0} is the number of images left out because their results are already there.

data.name: Empty_Description
data.value: A neural network enlarges the image 2–8 times and fills in the details. You can add several files at once; they are processed one after another.

data.name: Empty_Formats
data.value: PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WebP, HEIC · Ctrl+O · Ctrl+V to paste

data.name: Empty_Title
data.value: Drag photos or a folder here

data.name: Error_NoneUpscaled
data.value: The file could not be upscaled. {1}|None of the {0} files could be upscaled. {1}
data.comment: Plural forms separated by |, as many as the language has; {0} is the number of files (always 2 or more), {1} the first file's error.

data.name: Error_OutputFolder
data.value: Can't save to the output folder: {0} Choose another folder or save next to the originals.

data.name: Existing
data.comment: A label beside the list of what to do with a result from an earlier run.

data.name: Existing_KeepBoth
data.value: Keep it, number the new one
data.comment: The new result gets a number: photo_x4 (2).png.

data.name: Existing_Replace
data.value: Replace it with the new one

data.name: Existing_Skip
data.comment: The image whose result is already there is not upscaled again.

data.name: File_AlreadyThere
data.comment: {0} is the result's file name.

data.name: Files
data.comment: Plural forms separated by |, as many as the language has; {0} is the count.

data.name: Friendly_AccessDenied
data.value: Access to the file or folder was denied. Choose a different output folder.

data.name: Friendly_FileNotFound
data.value: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.

data.name: Friendly_Gpu
data.value: The GPU couldn't handle this model. Choose a different device or tile size under "Settings", or a lighter model.

data.name: Friendly_IO
data.value: Couldn't read or write the file. {0}

data.name: Language_Restart
data.value: The new language takes effect after Krupno is restarted.

data.name: NameWithModel
data.value: Add the model to the file name

data.name: NameWithModel_Example
data.comment: Keep photo.jpg as it is; {0} is the name its result gets, such as photo_x4_4xBHI_dat2_real.png.

data.name: NoModels
data.value: No models yet. Put .onnx files in the models folder and refresh the list.

data.name: NonCommercial_ToolTip
data.value: CC BY-NC-SA license: non-commercial use only

data.name: Note_DirectMLUnavailable
data.value: DirectML is unavailable, running on the CPU

data.name: Pasted_FileName
data.comment: The name of the file a pasted image is saved to; {0} is the date and time.

data.name: SeamlessTiles_Description
data.value: Twice the overlap between tiles (64 px): no visible seams even with deep models, but more tiles to run: about 1.5 times as many for a 1920 × 1200 photo with auto tiles.

data.name: Settings_Processing
data.comment: A group in "Settings": device, tiles, TTA.

data.name: Settings_Results
data.comment: A section of "Settings": the names of the results, and what happens to one from an earlier run.

data.name: Settings_ToolTip
data.comment: The tooltip of the gear button that opens the settings window; Ctrl+, opens it too.

data.name: Settings_General
data.comment: A group in "Settings": the language and the update check.

data.name: SizePreview_EnterScale
data.value: Enter a scale above 0, up to {0}

data.name: SizePreview_SelectFile
data.value: Select a file to see the output size

data.name: Strength_Description
data.value: Below 100%, a plain resize of the original is mixed in: fewer invented textures, softer sharpening.

data.name: Summary_NoUpdateCheck
data.comment: In the summary in the tooltip of the settings button, when the update check is off.

data.name: TileSize_Description
data.value: Smaller tiles use less video memory. If memory runs out, the tile size is reduced automatically.

data.name: Toast_BusyNotOpened
data.value: Processing is running: these files weren't opened. Open them when it ends.

data.name: Toast_ClipboardBusy
data.value: The clipboard is in use by another app — try again

data.name: Toast_ClipboardEmpty
data.value: The clipboard holds no image or files

data.name: Toast_ErrorDetailsCopied
data.value: Error details copied — paste them into a bug report

data.name: Toast_NoImagesInSelection
data.value: The selection contains no supported images

data.name: SetupRunning
data.value: Krupno is being installed. Try again once the installer has finished.
data.comment: Setup is replacing Krupno's files: no processing starts, and "Update" waits for it, on the update line or as a toast.

data.name: Tta_Description
data.value: The image is processed in all 8 rotations and mirrorings, and the results are averaged: a little less noise and fewer artifacts that lean one way, but 8 times slower.

data.name: Update_Available
data.comment: {0} is the new version, such as 0.3.0.

data.name: Update_CantStart
data.value: Couldn't start the installer of Krupno {0}: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the new version, {1} the reason Windows gave.

data.name: Update_CloseOthers
data.value: Close the other Krupno windows and the command-line tool first, then try again.
data.comment: The installer replaces the files the other windows and the command-line tool are using.

data.name: Update_CloseOthersAllUsers
data.value: Close the other Krupno windows and the command-line tool first, those of the other users of this computer too, then try again.
data.comment: For an installation for all users: the installer replaces the files the other windows and the command-line tool are using, other users' included, whose windows can't be closed from here.

data.name: Update_Download
data.comment: Opens the release page in the browser.

data.name: Update_Downloading
data.comment: {0} is the new version, {1} the percentage downloaded.

data.name: Update_Failed
data.comment: {0} is the new version, {1} the reason (Update_Mismatch, or the network's error).

data.name: Update_Install
data.comment: Downloads the new version and installs it; Krupno closes and starts again.

data.name: Update_Installed
data.comment: Shown once Krupno has started again after the update; {0} is the new version.

data.name: Update_Installing
data.comment: Setup has started; Krupno closes once it begins installing. {0} is the new version.

data.name: Update_Mismatch
data.value: the downloaded file doesn't match the checksum published with the release
data.comment: The reason in Update_Failed: the installer's SHA-256 isn't the one in the release's SHA256SUMS.txt.

data.name: Update_NotInstalled
data.value: The update to Krupno {0} wasn't installed.
data.comment: After the update Krupno started again in its old version: Setup failed or was canceled. {0} is the new version.

data.name: Update_SetupLog
data.comment: Opens the installer's log of the update that wasn't installed.

data.name: Update_WhatsNew
data.comment: Opens the release page in the browser.

data.name: Upscale_FilesScale
data.comment: {0} is the number of files (3 files), {1} the scale (×4) or a target size (to 3840 px wide).

data.comment: {0} is the scale (×4) or a target size (to 3840 px wide).
